cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a small empty Western playhouse sound-effects booth behind the stage — she tries the humble job behind a river-goddess play: gently rolling dry peas across a tilted rain drum to make a soft shower sound; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; an outdoor court for tennis or basketball — sitting on the ground; a space-station docking bay with a sleek shuttle on its pad and long light strips — lying on her front; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — standing; a quiet orbital apartment laundry alcove with rounded unlettered washer doors — after a day of ceremonial composure she patiently finds the matching sock by comparing two almost identical narrow stripe patterns; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — smooths a ruffled feather of a white feather fan with her fingertips; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — seated on a chair; a neon-lit game arcade — pulls a soft wisp off a cloud of pink cotton candy on a stick; a bus shelter on a quiet street — seated sideways on a stool or bench; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — holds her keepsake at chest height
